metas.name: Porky's Poultry Plant
metas.description: Porky Pig is raising chickens, ducks, and geese. Many birds have fallen victim to the hawk. Porky's going to do everything he can to fight back.

metas.name: Little Beau Porky
metas.description: Porky's in the foreign legion. But he's not allowed to fight; all he can do is scrub camels, and he's not particularly good at that. The other soldiers ride off to find the evil Ali Mode, leaving Porky behind. Ali Mode notices, and tries to gain entrance to the fort, first by tricking Porky, then by

metas.name: Porky in the North Woods
metas.description: Porky Pig runs a game refuge. Despite the abundant signs to the contrary, Jean-Baptiste the trapper sets numerous traps, ensnaring many animals.

metas.name: Porky's Road Race
metas.description: It's race day, and first prize is $2 million (less $1,999,998.37 in taxes). Porky's little car is matched against cars driven by stars of yesteryear, including Laurel and Hardy and Charlie Chaplin. When the black #13 driven by "Borax Karoff" makes a bid for the finish line, can Porky fend him off?

metas.name: Porky's Romance
metas.description: The introduction cartoon for Petunia Pig deals with Porky Pig's courtship with her. Once he's won her hand in marriage, he fantasizes about his future with her, which doesn't seem very appealing.

metas.name: Porky's Building
metas.description: Porky and another contractor are competing to submit the lower bid for a new city hall. When they submit identical bids, the city has them compete, whichever finishes first gets the job.

metas.name: Porky's Railroad
metas.description: Porky is the engineer on the most pathetic train in the fleet. After some routine episodes (using pepper to get the engine to sneeze itself up a hill, chasing a cow off the tracks, only to discover too late that it's been replaced by a very angry bull), Porky gets word that he's going to be replaced

metas.name: Speaking of the Weather
metas.description: It's midnight at the bookstore and all the book and magazine characters are coming to life. When a bulldog from an adventure book uses a Boswell Sisters-like performance by girls in a travel magazine as a distraction to rob a bank, he is chased, caught, and sentenced to, of course "Life" (the magazi

metas.name: The Case of the Stuttering Pig
metas.description: Porky Pig and his family inherit Uncle Solomon's estate, but if they die everything goes to the lawyer, who turns himself into a Mr. Hyde-style monster in an effort to kill off the pigs.

metas.name: Porky's Double Trouble
metas.description: Porky Pig has some problems when his mobster lookalike decides to frame him for a bank job.

metas.name: The Woods Are Full of Cuckoos
metas.description: Forest animals participate in the Woodland Community Swing Variety Show on radio station KUKU.

metas.name: Porky at the Crocadero
metas.description: The Crocadero nightclub. Porky has his diploma from the Sucker Correspondence School of music, and has dreams of being a bandleader, but he's broke. He gets a job at the club washing dishes. His boss mistakes Porky going after a fly for loafing and fires him. His bandleaders don't show, and he bring

metas.name: Now That Summer Is Gone
metas.description: Summer is gone, and throughout the forest young squirrels are working hard gathering acorns for the long cold winter ahead. But one such squirrel has a better idea: winning acorns by shooting dice.

metas.name: Porky the Fireman
metas.description: Fireman Porky and friends try to save a theatrical boarding house and its inhabitants from an inferno.

metas.name: Have You Got Any Castles
metas.description: A night in a small library. The characters of famous books come to life, referring to movie versions of these books.

metas.name: Porky's Spring Planting
metas.description: Porky and his dog, Streamline, plant a large garden. The neighbor chickens see the garden as one big buffet/cafeteria.

metas.name: The Major Lied 'Til Dawn
metas.description: We open on a big game hunter telling a little boy (a caricture of child star Freddie Bartholomew) stories about hunting in the jungles of Africa. He tells him a story about a day he was hunting there. The game hunter gets help from African natives to catch some animals, with some odd results. Sight

metas.name: Wholly Smoke
metas.description: A neighborhood bully convinces Porky to take a puff from his cigar, causing Porky to hallucinate a smoke-man named Nick O. Teen, along with a musical number done by cigars, cigarettes and pipes in the likeness of the 3 Stooges, etc.

metas.name: Cracked Ice
metas.description: It's ice skating time. After a few generic ice-skating gags, we get to the main story. An animal falls through the ice, and a pig doing W.C. Fields (W.C. Squeals, apparently) calls for help from a Saint Bernard dog. The dog dispenses a drink, and Squeals begins scheming to get some himself. First he

metas.name: Little Pancho Vanilla
metas.description: Little Pancho Vanilla dreams of becoming a bullfighter, but his mother tells him that's impossible. The greatest bullfighter in Mexico, Don Jose, is coming to town; Pancho tells the local women he's better, so he goes to the amateur tryout, but he gets thrown out because he's so small. The bull quic

metas.name: You're an Education
metas.description: The brochures in a travel agency spring to life.

metas.name: Porky Pig's Feat
metas.description: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck owe an outrageous sum to the Broken Arms Hotel. The manager thwarts their efforts to escape without paying their bill.

metas.name: Scrap Happy Daffy
metas.description: During World War Two, Daffy Duck owns a junkyard which collects scrap metal to use in building weapons to continue the Allied fight against the Axis powers. Hitler reads about Daffy's scrap pile and about Daffy's stated intent to win the war with junk and, after throwing a fit and chewing a carpet l

metas.name: Puss n' Booty
metas.description: Woman wonders why her little pet birds keep disappearing. Rudolph the cat knows, but other than burping feathers, he's not saying. But it looks like he's met his match when the woman orders another bird from the pet shop: a little yellow canary named "Petey".

metas.name: I Got Plenty of Mutton
metas.description: A wolf, deprived of meat by war rationing and starving, sees an article in the newspaper about a sheepdog leaving his flock to join the army and thinks it will be easy pickings. However, if he had read the rest of the article, he would know that the flock is now guarded by the ram Killer Diller, a m

metas.name: Swooner Crooner
metas.description: Porky Pig's egg farm faces production problems when a crooning rooster distracts the hens from their jobs.

metas.name: Brother Brat
metas.description: A "Rosie the Riveter" type is in need of a baby-sitter for her awful child. The only person available is a clueless Porky Pig. His only instructions are to use a book of child psychology. After fruitless attempts to control the brat, his mother returns to show Porky how to use the book - as a paddle

metas.name: Plane Daffy
metas.description: Daffy Duck is a message courier bird delivering a military secret that a femme fatale Nazi spy is determined to get.

metas.name: Booby Hatched
metas.description: A duck struggles mightily and finally hatches her eggs in the bitter cold. All but one, that is: poor little Robespierre. Mama doesn't notice him missing until after he has sprouted legs and run off in search of warmth.

metas.name: The Stupid Cupid
metas.description: Cupid (Elmer Fudd) is on the prowl around the farm. With his ever-accurate arrows, he spreads love to sometimes unwilling recipients. But when he sets his sights on Daffy, the duck wants no part of it. When Elm...erm...Cupid fires the largest arrow at his disposal at the hapless duck, Daffy falls fo

metas.name: The Unruly Hare
metas.description: When Elmer Fudd disturbs Bugs with his railroad surveying, Bugs fights back.

metas.name: Behind the Meat-Ball
metas.description: A dog, starved for meat, goes to different lengths to get a steak back from a little dog that keeps out-smarting him.

metas.name: A Tale of Two Mice
metas.description: Babitt and Catstello return; their goal: steal the cheese the cat is guarding.

metas.name: Nasty Quacks
metas.description: A doting father gives a cute little duckling to his little daughter. That duckling grows up to become Daffy Duck, who soon develops quite a night life, which he loudly explains at breakfast, in the process of eating everything in sight. When the exasperated father's attempts at violently removing Da

metas.name: Hare Remover
metas.description: Elmer Fudd is an amateur scientist who wants to turn a normal character into a devilish fiend; he's all out of experimental animals. Enter Bugs Bunny.
